subject.title: OpenWebUI image uploads reach image tool as empty image via /v1/chat/completions on 2026.5.18

question: Should maintainers obtain or reproduce a redacted current-main OpenWebUI image-upload trace before accepting any further core change to the Chat Completions image path?
rationale: Current main already advertises standard `image_url` support, but the issue’s historical empty tool value does not reveal whether the remaining discrepancy is OpenWebUI serialization, endpoint policy, or a later OpenClaw conversion step.

options.title: Capture a current trace
options.body: Request or reproduce a redacted OpenWebUI request plus matching Gateway trace, then fix only the confirmed conversion boundary.

options.title: Close as unsupported client shape
options.body: Close only if a capture proves OpenWebUI sends a nonstandard payload outside the documented image contract and no compatibility commitment is desired.

recommendation.title: Capture a current trace
recommendation.body: Request or reproduce a redacted OpenWebUI request plus matching Gateway trace, then fix only the confirmed conversion boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor introduced the relevant standard image-part support and is the strongest history-based routing candidate for confirming the intended payload contract.
